People.want: Wants to access the CCC Agency Portal to complete morning tasks
People.knowledgeLevel: Does not know what a proxy is or what the proxy error means
People.role: Agency representative contacting support about access issues

People.want: Wants to identify the cause and guide the agency to restore portal access
People.knowledgeLevel: Can check agency profile status and confirm system health; understands proxy-related connectivity issues
People.role: AAA Insurance Support Desk operator providing guidance to agencies

Issue.title: Cannot access CCC Agency Portal
Issue.description: The agency representative cannot access the CCC Agency Portal due to the error 'ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED' while trying to perform morning tasks

Issue.title: Do not know what a proxy is
Issue.description: The agency representative does not understand what a proxy is despite seeing a proxy-related error

Issue.title: Do not know whether the problem is with the AAA Insurance site
Issue.description: The agency representative is unsure if the access problem is caused by AAA Insurance systems or by their own network

Solution.title: Report to JJJ Agency IT to restart the proxy server
Solution.description: Because the error indicates the agency's proxy server is down or misconfigured, contact JJJ Agency's IT department to restart the proxy server

Solution.title: Understand that a proxy routes company internet traffic and the error indicates the agency proxy is down or misconfigured
Solution.description: The operator explains that a proxy is a server used by the company to route internet traffic, and the error 'ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED' indicates the agency's proxy is down or misconfigured

Solution.title: Confirm that AAA Insurance systems are running normally
Solution.description: The operator confirms that AAA Insurance systems are operating normally, so the issue is not on their side
